external_sources.note: 仅采集域名候选；达到置信度门槛后按自动审核规则处理。上游规则策略、模块、脚本、MITM、DNS、Rewrite 一律不直接采纳。

release_policy.rule_scope: DOMAIN only; DOMAIN-SUFFIX is never generated automatically
release_policy.approval_rule: Rules are assigned only by deterministic, machine-verifiable source agreement and local safety gates. No AI, model API, or manual per-domain review is used. Unsupported policy classes remain unpublished.

approval_criteria.description: Both configured current policy-labelled sources must list the exact candidate and agree on REJECT; evidence publisher and group identifiers must match source configuration.
Existing first-match domain rules, conditional AND/OR/NOT rules, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, URL-REGEX, skip-proxy and protected-domain checks must all pass.

mandatory_vetoes: Any exact or suffix rule with a different effective policy blocks publication
Any unresolved conditional AND/OR/NOT overlap blocks publication
Any critical-function protection-list match blocks publication
Any skip-proxy direct-bypass match blocks publication
Any malformed source, invalid domain, duplicate ledger key or failed validator blocks publication
release_policy.review_status: Candidates below confidence 0.80 or with fewer than two independent credible sources remain REVIEW; conflicts and critical-function risks are held.
release_policy.publish_gate: No automatic writes to original or canonical baseline. Derived output only.
release_policy.confidence_interpretation: Operational evidence score, not a statistical probability or guarantee of safe blocking.
release_policy.direct_proxy_policy: DIRECT and PROXY remain REVIEW until dedicated policy-labelled source sets with independent publisher corroboration are configured.

managed_config_guard.description: Current user-managed subscription file; automation must not modify it.
